title: Defend North Heaven to the death
summary: Mu Chen chooses to fight the Yellow Dragon Sovereign rather than run, and Luo Li arrives to stand with him; the Sovereign says Beiming is blocked above the Nine Heavens and no help is coming. At the North Heaven Gate, once every freshman is inside, three old elders spring a formation on the three attacking Sovereigns and destroy their own divine souls to hold them, teaching the freshmen a final lesson that the strong exist to protect others, under the academy motto 'A blazing sun exists to shine, while the rising sun is destined to climb ever higher'. Fei Qingsong flees the trap and turns on those shut outside, and Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong prepare to fight side by side against a Sovereign, with Mu Gu present. The Yellow Dragon Sovereign plays with Mu Chen and Luo Li, giving them 30 minutes to scratch him; Mu Chen calls on his Four Gods and on Jiu You, and the black paper seals the Sovereign for an instant, long enough for a strike that wounds him. As the Sovereign moves to kill them both, Qing Yanjing's power appears: 'How dare you touch my child.'
